context_for_next_testing_agent: THE FORGE is a NEW 24-page cinematic presentation similar to INGABO. Routes: /proposals/preview/the-forge (no auth, direct access), /proposals/the-forge (email gate). All data hardcoded in TheForgePresentation.jsx. Features: Gold 'THE FORGE' letter ignition animation on pages 1 and 24 with amber glow, video on page 2 with autoplay, ember particles (Embers component) floating upward, character pages 10-14 with CharPage template, page 11 ADESUWA has image on LEFT side, page 14 MARCUS HALE has cold blue background (#080C14) for temperature contrast, CSS-only animations via data-active attribute and animation classes (aig=ignite, adi=drop-in, abu=brightness-up, asl/asr=slide, af=fadeIn, au=fadeUp, atc=typeChar), full keyboard/touch navigation, opacity crossfade transitions (400ms), progress bar at bottom. Color palette: Warm black #0E0C09, Gold #C4841A, Amber #E87A2A, Off-white #F5ECD7, Cold blue #080C14 (villain only). Fonts: Playfair Display serif for headings (.forge-serif), Inter sans-serif for body. Images in /app/frontend/public/images/theforge/ (16 images + 1 video ~81MB)
